images.title: Xbox Elite Wireless Controller (Series 1, model 1698), front and back
images.author: unreal-ng
images.terms: vector drawing from measured dimensions; photos used as references only, nothing traced

references.what: the outline (trace.py, the half mirrored, overlap 0.990) and the control positions: a straight top view of a model 1698 with the faceted D-pad, scaled to 153 mm across; 108 mm deep traced
references.use: measured geometry only; no pixels shipped

references.what: front: the satin metal plate round Guide, the metal bumpers, the 1 / 2 profile switch under View / Menu; no Share, no profile lights
references.author: Mliu92

references.what: back: the four metal paddles P1-P4 (P1 / P2 on the right hand, upper / lower), the hair-trigger locks beside the battery cover; no USB-C port (micro-USB on the top edge)
references.author: Mliu92
references.note: drawn as the pad turned over towards the viewer (triggers at the bottom), so the right hand's paddles stay on the right; positions measured on the photo scaled to 153 mm, about 2 mm
